summary: Audited catalogues shared-shop-cta against exact real-pixel crops at x=40, y=966, 1840 x 230. The comparison's expected y=2919 is outside the 1850 px reference and is a proven source-coordinate defect; the visible component still has typography, button, and gradient mismatches.
issues: VIS-CATALOGUES-CTA-001 (high) — property: retained comparison geometry; expected record: y=2919; actual source pixels: CTA begins at y=966 in the 1850 px frozen reference, matching rendered y=966; fix: correct the source-section coordinate extraction rather than moving the implementation to an impossible off-canvas location.

VIS-CATALOGUES-CTA-002 (medium) — property: gradient; expected: darker green center/right transition as in the reference; actual: rendered right half is noticeably brighter lime and the transition differs across the panel; fix: match the source gradient stops, positions, and colors.

VIS-CATALOGUES-CTA-003 (medium) — property: typography and button alignment; expected: source heading glyph metrics and button centered around y=122; actual: heading glyphs differ and button is approximately 7 px too high with different label weight; fix: apply source text metrics and vertical centering.
